title: The Waltz Feel
body: A waltz is in 3/4 time — three beats per bar, with an emphasis on beat 1. Count: ONE two three ONE two three. The melody should breathe and flow; don't rush the phrasing.

title: Waltz Opening
caption: The melody starts on E, moves to G and A — a stepwise rise. Bar 2 descends back to C. This rise-and-fall shape is the heartbeat of waltz phrasing.
